question: Which Indian bowler took 25 wickets to win IPL 2025 Purple Cap?
solution:
The correct answer is **Prasidh Krishna.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prasidh Krishna** of **Gujarat Titans **won the** IPL 2025 Purple Cap**, finishing as the leading wicket-taker with **25 wickets in 15 matches.**
 
• He secured the award by topping the** bowling charts, ahead of other top performers in the tournament.**
 
• The **Purple Cap is awarded to the leading wicket-taker in the Indian Premier League.**
 
• His performance was consistent throughout the tournament, helping his team significantly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Purple Cap Award:**

 
 
• The **Purple Cap** is an **IPL** award presented to the **leading wicket-taker** of the season. It was introduced in the inaugural season in **2008**.
 
• If two or more bowlers are tied for the **most wickets**, the bowler with the **lower economy rate** is awarded the **Purple Cap**.
 
 
 
• **Jasprit Bumrah (Mumbai Indians):**
 
 
• In the **IPL 2024** season, **Jasprit Bumrah** was one of the top contenders, finishing with **20 wickets** in **13 matches**.
 
• He maintained an extraordinary **economy rate** of **5.96**, which was the best among the top wicket-takers in that edition.
 
 
 
• **Yuzvendra Chahal (Rajasthan Royals):**
 
 
• **Yuzvendra Chahal** holds the record for being the **first bowler** to reach **200 wickets** in **IPL** history, achieving this milestone in **April 2024**.
 
• He previously won the **Purple Cap** in **2022** by taking **27 wickets** for the **Rajasthan Royals**.
 
 
 
• **Arshdeep Singh (Punjab Kings (PBKS)**
 
 
• He is a premier left-arm fast bowler who has been a cornerstone of the** Punjab Kings (PBKS) in the IPL since his debut in 2019.**
 
• Known for his exceptional death-bowling yorkers, he has taken over 100+ IPL wickets in 90+ matches.
